# Rachel Kirmitsaki

> Independent Product Design Consultant for complex B2B products, fintech and enterprise platforms. London, working remotely.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product design consultant — discovery, UX/UI, design systems and prototyping.
- [Portfolio](/work): Product design, websites and brand design case studies.
- [Field Notes](/field-notes): Longer pieces on product direction, teams, systems, customers and technology.
- [About](/about): Background across cybersecurity, financial markets and academic research.
- [Contact](/contact): Availability for contract engagements.
